label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
@ReneeK_Meyerland, I'm the owner of Lotus Garden Nails. First, I'm really sorry your toe hurt. I mean that. I know a week of pain and not wearing shoes is no small thing, and I'm glad you got it treated.

I want to tell you what I know from our side. I'm not trying to fight with you. You've been our customer for two years and I value that.

You came in Saturday, Oct 24 for a deluxe pedicure, $45. Your technician was my niece Vy. She has been licensed for 3 years. She was born and raised here in Houston and speaks English fine. She is a little shy, that's all.

Here is how we do every pedicure. All metal tools come from the autoclave and are opened from a sealed pouch in front of the customer. Files and buffers are new for each person, and you take yours home. We put a new plastic liner in the tub every time. Our state inspection in August 2026 passed with no violations, and the paper is on the wall at the front.

About the cuticle: Vy remembers that you asked her to cut more, and she told you she didn't want to go too deep. You said it was fine, that you always have it done that way. I'm not saying this to blame you. A small cut can happen in any salon, even when everyone is careful. But I don't want people to think we were careless or that the tools were dirty, because that's not what happened.

When you came back on Nov 2 and showed me your toe, I offered to refund the full $45 and pay your urgent care copay if you bring the receipt. That offer is still open today. I know you wanted more than that, and I said no to $300 cash and a free pedicure for a year. That's more than I can do, but it doesn't change that I want to make this right in a fair way.

I opened this salon in 2007 after working for my aunt, so it's 19 years now. In that time we never had one infection complaint. So this one is hard for me, and I'm taking it seriously. You said you filed with the state. That's your right, and we will cooperate with anything they ask.

One more thing, and I say it gently. Some comments here say all nail salons are dirty. I understand people are worried after reading your post, but it hurts when everyone gets put in the same group. A lot of us work hard and follow the rules. Vy read this thread and cried, and she now says she wants to quit doing nails. She is a good technician and a good person, and I hope people remember there is a real young woman behind these words.

Renee, please call me at the salon or come in and we can sit and talk, just us, no rush. I would like to hear it from you directly and see what else we can do. I'd rather fix this face to face than in a comment box.

And thank you, Marisol, for speaking up kindly and for asking the owner to talk. It meant a lot to me and my team. 4 years is a long time, and we appreciate you.

Thank you all for reading.

Owner, Lotus Garden Nails (Bellaire)
